evidence.summary: publishEventTx takes shared restore generation then collection lock and commits event/fanout, group creation or response observation/member/closure together. Snapshot uses committed transaction deliveries; repeated publication request returns cached original metadata. Response group row and member updates stay under collection lock; sweep takes same lock order. Restore takes exclusive generation and closes open groups without replay. Delivery acknowledgment does not mutate group membership.

evidence.summary: Expired, empty or oversized group creation rolls back fanout and returns explicit group code; scheduled versions are retained skipped rather than poisoning ticks. Unexpected SQL errors propagate and roll back. Invalid/mismatched ordinary response metadata is retained unmatched, duplicates do not replace first reply and late cannot reopen. Due collection closes under all/partial policy separately from request failure or process cancellation. Status rechecks response payload eligibility, copies no bodies and reports task outcome unknown. Fresh worker context supplies stable slot-owned response arguments distinct from completion.

evidence.summary: Successful collected exits for make test-integration, make test-lifecycle, final make check, focused parent tests and independently rerun reviewer race tests. Publication retry preserves snapshot, ack alone does not count, duplicate/distinct recipient races collect once, SQL observation failure rolls back event/fanout, deadline sweep and restore close groups. Exact source forgetting hides payload while preserving response history. Real CLI/API restart and systemd context reply probes pass. Lifecycle compares full populated group/member/observation rows after disposable backup/restore. New reviewer tests ran separately after full integration; no production data or provider acceptance claim.

assertions.text: Publication, delivery snapshot and group creation share one transaction; reply observation and member/terminal updates share the response publication transaction. Concurrent tests and SQL failure injection preserve the selected invariants.

Acknowledgment does not fill a member; first matching reply does. Deadline and restore close groups, late replies cannot reopen, and current forgetting or sensitivity hides unavailable payload references.
Use fixed actual delivery snapshots, explicit all/partial policies and historical collection separate from payload availability and task acceptance.

alternatives.option: Snapshot actual deliveries and collect explicit replies in existing publication transactions
Read current topic membership during aggregation
Treat delivery acknowledgment as a successful response

verification_criteria: Disposable integration and race tests, static checks
Real CLI/API restart and systemd reply-context probes
Full populated response-group rows survive backup/restore
reopening_conditions: A pool or dynamic-recipient workflow needs response aggregation
New publication/restore paths change transaction lock ordering
Measured collection or observation backlog exceeds the bounded operating contract
residual_risk: No provider-specific task acceptance, throughput or full-v1 acceptance claim.
Collection deadlines are distinct from process deadlines; failed deliveries do not count as replies.
Source inspection and tests cover selected invariants, not every possible future consumer or failure schedule.
